model: Liebert iCOM v4 (Challenger 3000, Challenger ITR, CW, Deluxe System/3, DS, DSE, PeX, HPM) via BASgatewayLX
equipment_type: Precision cooling unit (computer room air handler)
applies_to: Liebert precision cooling units with iCOM v4 controls (Challenger 3000/ITR, CW, Deluxe System/3, DS, DSE, PeX, HPM), read over Modbus by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for Liebert iCOM v4 units (tables 6 and 8 of the Liebert Modbus map): 641 objects (418 AI, 223 BI). None is polled in the profile as published. It covers lockouts and system on/off state, fan, cooling, free-cooling, reheat, humidifier and dehumidifier states, the full event list, setpoints and thresholds (many in both °F and °C), and return, supply and remote sensor readings.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Liebert_ICOM_V4_Table_6_and_8_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the Liebert iCOM Modbus tables 6 and 8 (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/LiebertIntelliSlot.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.

None of the 641 rows is flagged for polling in the profile as published; tick the points you need in the gateway before any object is served. Each object's description says it is not polled by default.

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.

Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Free Cooling Internal Control Mode; Humidity Proportional Control Type; Supply Air Temperature Set Point...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.
Temperature values come in pairs (°F and °C) with the same name; the units column tells them apart.

integration.summary: Tick the unit state, return/supply temperature, humidity and setpoint objects first. Every object is an input, so setpoints cannot be written through this profile.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
